title: Why Testing Matters
description: Understand the importance of testing in software development.

slides.title: The Testing Mindset 🧪
slides.content:
# Tests Are Your Safety Net

Without tests, you cannot confidently refactor, add features, or fix bugs. Every change risks breaking existing functionality.

**Benefits of testing:**
- Catch bugs early.
- Document expected behavior.
- Enable safe refactoring.
- Build confidence in your code.

Spring Boot provides excellent test support through **spring‑boot‑starter‑test**.

quizData.question: What is a primary benefit of writing automated tests?

options.text: They replace the need for code reviews

quizData.explanation: Tests provide a safety net that allows you to change code with confidence, catching regressions quickly.

slides.title: Test Pyramid 🧗
slides.content: The **test pyramid** suggests many unit tests (fast, isolated), fewer integration tests (slower, test interactions), and even fewer end‑to‑end tests (slow, full system). Spring Boot helps you write tests at every level.
